correctness.rationale: With X indicator of a retained attachment to the root cluster, Y of attachment to an original leaf, and K original leaves also in root cluster, the actual conditional moments E[X|F]=rR/n, E[Y|F]=L/n, E[XY|F]=rK/n yield three first-moment recurrences and a mixed covariance recursion. E K=r A_n/(1+r) for n>=2; setting D_n=C_n/A_n telescopes D_(n+1)=(n+r-1)D_n/(n+r)+r(1-r)/[2(1+r)(n+r)] to the exact formula. Independent exact full enumeration of every recursive tree and all edge-retention patterns for n=2..6 at r=1/2 confirmed C_3=1/16, C_4=5/48, C_5=35/256, C_6=21/128. Factorial-moment identity gives Var(R)=2 Γ(n+2r)/[Γ(1+2r)Γ(n)]-A_n-A_n², leaf variance n/12 for n>=3; gamma convexity makes v(r)>0 for interior r and yields the stated universal correlation exponent. Finite tests corroborate and do not replace recurrence and asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Only fixed interior retention r; no uniform bounds as r tends to 0 or 1.
